hypothesis: Using independent basic/cast allowances, attack resets and useful defensive casts will increase matched development win rate over the edit base; unchanged or lower win rate falsifies it.
rationale: Base never casts, so spell damage and reset capacity are unused, including on random Focus builds. Beta adds unit spells but misses resets/AoE; other frozen sources are basic-only. Prior fixed-composition/routing experiment has map-specific losses and is not transplanted.
manual_safety_review: Movement flag disables exclusive spells after walking. Acting before navigation returns to caller and prevents later movement.
Reset uses self cast without range query; fresh visible targets and can_attack checked after cast.
Unit target categories, life, visibility and range checked; AoE aims only at a visible unit.
Channels retained; cast-only turns allowed; low fuel skips additional path planning.
At most one ordinary basic, one normal cast and one post-cast basic; live allowance checks guard each action.
unknowns: Comparative outcome and actual fuel headroom unmeasured.
Broader spell range can divert turns from banking and farming; AoE may wake other camps.
Random builds, implicit capture/navigation and spawn departure remain inherited weaknesses.

final_check.limitations: Smoke match IDs and pass status do not establish completed matches, coverage, fuel headroom or comparative strength.
